# Privacy Policy for AI Ad Purifier

**Last Updated:** July 12, 2026

AI Ad Purifier ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and disclose information when you use our Chrome Extension, AI Ad Purifier - One-Click Ad Blocker.

## 1. Information We Collect

### A. Local Storage
We store the following information locally on your device using Chrome's local storage API:
* **Activation Code / Order ID:** Used to verify your premium license status.
* **Custom Ad Blocking Rules:** Stored rules and element selectors generated by the AI to hide ads.

### B. Active Page Content (DOM)
When you trigger the "AI One-Click Clean" feature, the extension reads the condensed Document Object Model (DOM) of the active tab. This text representation is securely sent via HTTPS to our cloud backend to generate CSS selectors for blocking ads.

### C. Personal Data
We do not collect, store, or sell any personal identity information, location data, passwords, or financial information. Payments are handled entirely by third-party processors (Waffo).

## 2. Third-Party Services
We use third-party APIs (DeepSeek) via our secure proxy backend to process DOM structure analysis. No personal user data is sent to these services.

## 3. Data Protection
Your active page DOM data is processed in-memory and is never stored permanently on our servers or databases.
